title: Late-Cancellation Fee Entries on an Appointment Series — Action Reference
content:
Action reference, Patient Services Center systems.

## Where the fee applies

A late-cancellation fee on an Appointment Series is charged for a booked appointment that the patient cancelled before the appointment day with notice below the late-cancellation notice period of the series' format, and it is worked out on the most recent cancellation recorded on the series that carries no minutes late, the one with the latest appointment date.

The fee is booked as one late-cancellation fee entry on the series, tied to the recorded cancellation it is for, in US dollars to the cent. The entry raises the missed-visit fees owed on the series by the amount charged.

## The action: `assess_late_cancellation_fee_706e910e`

**Capability.** The tool books one late-cancellation fee against the patient's appointment series, tied to the recorded cancellation it is for, and raises the missed-visit fees owed on that series by the amount charged. The patient sees the fee on the series' missed-visit balance and on the next statement. The tool records what it is given; it makes no judgement of its own on whether a fee is owed or how much.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks `assess_late_cancellation_fee_706e910e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `series_id` | the reference number of the patient's appointment series that carries the cancelled appointment, as returned by the appointment series lookup | text identifier |
| `source_event_id` | the reference number of the recorded cancellation entry the fee is for, as returned by the appointment history lookup for that series | text identifier |
| `amount` | the late-cancellation fee to charge, in USD | a positive number given to 2 decimal places (cents); stored exactly as passed after rounding to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the tool returns `fee_reference` (the reference number of the new fee entry; its presence means the fee was booked), `series_id` (the series charged), `fee_kind` (always `late_cancellation`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the fee booked), `appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the cancelled appointment), `assessed_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the fee was charged) and `missed_fee_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the missed-visit fees owed on the series once this fee is included). No other return or error is defined.

## Contract questions

- *Does one call cover several cancellations?* No. One call books one fee, tied to the one cancellation entry named in `source_event_id`.
- *What does the patient see?* The fee on the series' missed-visit balance and on the next statement.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A call with `series_id` set to a series reference, `source_event_id` set to the reference of that series' cancellation entry, and `amount` of 26.25 returns a new `fee_reference`, `fee_kind` `late_cancellation`, `amount` 26.25 and a `missed_fee_balance` raised by 26.25.
